statement: For a supplied fixed finite codebook and within the declared execution envelope, finite index words admit recoverable canonical rooted traces of actual native packet transitions; append preserves decoded concatenation, while this compiler's endpoint and deduplicated transition support do not recover its words.
source_laws: PN and inverse-PN with complete five-slot permutation
reader-phase-advance with actual phaseAdvanceWitness and supplied outside-reference coefficient retention rule
code: Fixed-width binary symbol indices; zero bit is PN followed by inverse-PN, one bit is a P reader-phase-advance. Every selected operation must come from the actual source and validate there.
retention: Keep occurrence order and multiplicity, whole source/target packets and chart roles, native faces, five-slot permutations, origins, phase frames and complete reader-phase witnesses. The supplied alphabet labels remain an explicit task-reference header.
controls: same cached model and deduplicated support for repeated zero loops
scope_boundary: This realizes supplied words as paths of actual native packet steps, not color queries, an autonomous forcing algorithm, a native admission of arbitrary codebook packages, a simultaneous occupied/E-exit-certified assembly, an Agda Resolve derivation or root closure. Endpoint counterexamples concern this compiler and these projections, not every possible endpoint encoding.
